fields.text: Create a short product-motion concept from an object and camera move. GLM Flash structures the brief; Omni Flash 1.1 renders 5s at 360p / 16:9 (video step $0.195, plus text). No upload required. Inspect stable object shape and coherent motion. The generated object is a concept, not an exact real product.
One unbranded matte sage-green insulated water bottle with a black screw cap on a stationary pale-gray studio plinth, neutral background, softbox lighting.

fields.system: Write one text-to-video prompt from the object brief and selected move. Preserve the object, material, color, setting and number of objects. Specify one continuous five-second shot with exactly the selected object and camera motion. Keep object geometry consistent; stable exposure and realistic contact shadows. Do not introduce weather, people, text, extra objects, cuts or additional camera moves. Output prompt only, 60-100 words.
